text:
Alex (Finance): Noticed GCP Marketplace invoice lines with truncated metering IDs -> can't map to resellers. Invoice GCP-MP-2028-04-02. Need quick fix before close. :grimacing:

Riya (Billing): Can you paste a sample line?

Alex (Finance): Sample: marketplace:us-central1:reseller-Sunbridge:meter-abcde12345xyz  Units: 1  ChargeUSD: 2,450.00  metering_id: "mb-1234567890abcdef..." (truncated)

Tom (Platform): We've seen a report that the GCP payload sometimes truncates metering_id to 20 chars when passing through the ingestion proxy. I can run a replay from raw storage for 04-01 -> 04-03 and re-run transforms to restore full ids. ETA 1.5h.

Marta (Partner Ops): Sunbridge says their metering ids are full length on their side. If reprocess won't work we'll need to post a manual chargeback.

recon-bot: Scan result: Unallocated GCP marketplace charges = $2,450.00 across 1 line. Recommend reprocess or manual journal.

Riya (Billing): If Platform can reprocess and recover ids we can auto-allocate. If not, Finance approves a temporary manual allocation to Sunbridge up to $2.5k. Alex confirm?

Alex (Finance): Confirmed. Approve manual fallback up to $2.5k. Tag entry "mp-temp-alloc" and reference GCP-MP-2028-04-02.

Tom (Platform): Kicked off replay job (job rp-gcp-442). Will post results.

recon-bot: Replay complete rp-gcp-442. Result: metering_id restored, allocation matched to reseller Sunbridge. Unallocated remaining = $0.00. Link: https://billing.internal/recon/GCP-MP-2028-04-02/rp-gcp-442

Riya (Billing): Verified allocation applied and invoice reconciled. No manual journal needed. Marking invoice as cleared for month close.

Marta (Partner Ops): Notified Sunbridge; they confirmed no action on their side required.

Alex (Finance): Thanks team. Tom please add a short note in runbook about proxy truncation and the replay steps. :white_check_mark:
